mechanism.identity: F87B frozen F60-anchored public bridge-reserve selector; differs from F86 global role-mass scoring
mechanism.online_inputs: Prior retained 12-byte records, current public 3-field event, current prefix index. No source seed, current/future question, expected answer, future public events, family, private truth labels.
mechanism.exact_baseline: Use F62._f60_step before every decision and assert it is among F62.actions legal transitions.
mechanism.trigger: Current incoming directed raw edge links two distinct nonidentical prior retained records: one endpoint appears in at least one retained record and the other endpoint appears in at least one different retained record; baseline does not preserve the incoming as a raw single-role record.
mechanism.override: Only then consider frozen F62.actions options which contain the exact raw incoming source edge, at most twelve records and the exact prior public-prefix audit; rank by number of records identical to frozen F60 baseline, then number of retained prior records, then frozen native enumeration order.
mechanism.default: Use bit-identical F60 _f60_step otherwise, with no learning or tuning.
mechanism.resource: 12 x 12-byte retained records, no persistent state besides memory. Query-time frozen F85 bounded global DP, identical across arms.
mechanism.failure_handling: No eligible alternative -> frozen F60 baseline, never synthesize an answer-aware edge or retain a prohibited state.
mechanism.one_time_decision: Frozen before examining the new guard; no post-result score changes.

prequalification.validity: Frozen source hashes, exact inherited F60 and F83 controls; independent 72-prefix F62 audit for F87B and F83; all 32 questions have uniquely provable public answers; all actions legal, no private data.
